frequency_question: How often does a central bank successfully initiate a rate hike within an 87-day window when entering a tightening bias?
membership_rule: Includes any institutional monetary policy committee meeting sequence in G20 emerging markets where inflation exceeds target bands and policy rates are held constant for at least two quarters prior.
coverage_note: 5 major modern inflation-targeting cycles; represents the complete population of relevant institutional friction tests under the current statutory framework.
known_gaps: Excludes minor inter-meeting emergency adjustments, focusing strictly on scheduled monetary policy committee decisions.
skeleton: 5 historical MPC tightening initiation cycles in India since 2010, evaluated for action within a rolling 90-day window following threshold breach.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 5 historical instances where structural friction did not successfully block the intervention.
validity_reason: Statutory frameworks of the MPC and institutional independence provisions remain stable over this multi-year horizon.
